correctness.rationale: Each paired matched edge pair in the triangular graph covers precisely three K_n labels and domination requires all but at most one original label be covered. With n=3k+1 this proves the sharp size 2k and forces equality into k disjoint P3 stars and a single hole. All legal fixed-size slides are exactly four per star (two hole-leaf, two center-leaf); the slot quotient by petal symmetries is exact. Connected token swapping on the k-square bouquet proves connectivity; S_n acts transitively; the local adjacency cases prove exactly 2k triangles through each vertex. Independent direct subset enumeration for n=4 and 7 and two separately structured exhaustive enumerators for n=4,7,10 verify N=12,630,75600; E=24,2520,453600; triangle totals 8,840,151200; and diameters 3,6,10. All-order diameter beyond n=10 is unproved.

value.rationale: Tight saturation at n=3k+1 produces a complete infinite classification of optimal pair-guard configurations of a classical strongly regular family and a nontrivial connected fixed-optimum reconfiguration space, with an explicit square-bouquet token-swap quotient. The all-order state/edge/triangle counts and first three exact geodesic profiles distinguish local mobility from mere numerical domination. This natural parameter regime, object and metric are independently motivated; no unsupported algorithmic gains are claimed.
